entities.name: UPF0173 metal-dependent hydrolase
observations: The 241-aa query sequence is an exact match to reviewed UniProt A9AY83, annotated as UPF0173 metal-dependent hydrolase Haur_4333 from Herpetosiphon aurantiacus.
Pfam scanning detects Lactamase_B_3 (PF13483; residues 5–201), Lactamase_B (PF00753; residues 8–89), and Lactamase_B_2 (PF12706; residues 23–202).

Homologs in Chloroflexus aurantiacus and Roseiflexus sp. are annotated as UPF0173 metal-dependent hydrolases; only generic hydrolase activity is supported, with no specific substrate/reaction retrieved.
